issue.title: Fixes GeoLineAggregator bugs

labels.name: :Analytics/Geo
labels.description: Indexing, search aggregations of geo points and shapes

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This commit unmutes and fixes tests around some GeoLineAggregator edge
cases.

- MergedGeoLines had a silly bug where it was accepting InternalGeoLines
  that were empty
- "complete" is measured by the heap-mode of the BucketedSort, which is a problem
  since if the length of the data equals the max-size, then it is difficult to know
  whether any values were discarded.
- GeoLineBucketSort had an array-resizing bug s/>/>=

Fixes #65473.
